description: This file contains a PHP trait 'EncryptionTraitV2' used for encrypting data streams within the AWS SDK, handling cipher configuration, encryption streams creation, and embedding encryption metadata.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Builds an encryption stream for plaintext data, encrypts it using specified options and materials provider, and populates the provided envelope with encryption metadata.

methods.name: getEncryptingStream
methods.description: Creates and returns an encryption stream for the given plaintext, using specified cipher options and content encryption key (CEK). Currently supports only 'gcm' cipher.
